fact: In July 2024 89,579 of the 147,984 households counted in the 2021 census (about 60.5%) were registered in the Cadastro Social Único, which grades households into four groups used to target cash transfers, school support, reduced water and electricity tariffs and health-fee exemptions.
title: Cadastro Social Único de Cabo Verde: Um instrumento estratégico para o reforço do sistema de proteção social
